patch_description:
Make selection genuinely maximin-focused and add a deterministic vectorized local polishing phase. The previous fitness gives the next-smallest triangles enough weight to select layouts with a materially worse bottleneck triangle. The revised score uses the minimum area as the decisive quantity, with only a tiny tie-breaking term.

After the population search, the best layout is polished by repeatedly proposing batches of small feasible coordinate changes, concentrating mostly on one-point moves. This is appropriate for the Heilbronn objective: at a near-optimal arrangement only a small active set of triangles is limiting, and moving one of their vertices is substantially more effective than continuing broad evolutionary mutations. All candidates are evaluated in vectorized form and only genuine minimum-area improvements are retained.
